test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment.

Ruby fell victim to the __green eyed monster.__
solution:
The correct answer is: **jealousy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"green eyed monster"** refers to jealousy, a feeling of envy or resentment towards someone because of their possessions, qualities, or luck. (ईर्ष्या)

 
 
• **Example:** His success in the business world aroused the **green eyed monster** in his colleagues.
 
 
 
• **"Jealousy"** is the correct substitution for the phrase "**green eyed monster**" as it conveys the same meaning. (ईर्ष्या)
 
 
• **Example:** She couldn't hide her **jealousy **when she saw her friend wearing a new dress.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Love** (प्रेम): A deep feeling of affection or attachment towards someone.

 
 
• **Example:** Their **love **for each other grew stronger with each passing day.
 
 
 
• **Flattery** (चापलूसी): Excessive and insincere praise given to someone, often to further one's own interests.
 
 
• **Example:** He used **flattery **to gain favours from his boss.
 
 
 
• **Hatred** (घृणा): Intense dislike or ill will towards someone.
 
 
• **Example:** Her **hatred **for injustice was evident in her actions.
